name: The Mars Colony
description: The first colonists of a new Mars settlement each took a different role and hail from a different world. Work out who's who.
clues: The Technician's distance is immediately below Eklund.
The colonist studying Lichen's distance is lower than both Bauer and the Medic.
The Captain's distance is lower than both Cho and the colonist studying Geode.
The Technician's distance is between Cho and the colonist studying Algae.
Cho's distance is between the colonist studying Plankton and the Technician.
